content.user_title: Draft Employment Contracts and HR Documents
content.value_statement: Employment documents need clear terms and consistent legal structure. This skill provides templates and checklists for offer letters, contracts, handbooks, and HR policies.
actual_capabilities: Draft offer letters with role, compensation, benefits, contingency, and acceptance sections.
Create employment agreement structures covering term, compensation, confidentiality, IP, restrictive covenants, and termination.
Generate employee handbook policy sections for equal opportunity, anti-harassment, attendance, PTO, holidays, conduct, technology, and social media.
Provide checklists for jurisdiction, employment type, required clauses, compensation, benefits, and signatures.
Include best-practice reminders to consult counsel and adapt templates to local employment law.
limitations: Does not provide jurisdiction-specific legal advice or replace licensed counsel.
Requires user-provided facts for role, location, compensation, benefits, and employment type.
Templates must be reviewed against current law and company policy before use.
Does not automate filing, signatures, payroll setup, or HRIS updates.

use_cases.title: Prepare Offer Letters
use_cases.description: Create consistent offer letters with compensation, benefits, contingencies, at-will language, and acceptance blocks.

use_cases.title: Draft Employment Agreements
use_cases.description: Build a first draft agreement with role duties, compensation, confidentiality, IP assignment, termination, and general provisions.

use_cases.title: Standardize Handbook Policies
use_cases.description: Generate handbook policy sections for workplace conduct, attendance, PTO, holidays, technology use, and social media.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Offer Letter
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft an employment offer letter for [role] in [jurisdiction]. Include start date, compensation, benefits, contingencies, at-will language if applicable, and signature blocks.

prompt_templates.title: Tailor an Employment Agreement
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an employment agreement for [employment type] in [jurisdiction]. Include duties, term, compensation, confidentiality, IP assignment, restrictive covenants if lawful, termination, and acknowledgments.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Handbook Section
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft handbook policies for [company type] covering equal employment opportunity, anti-harassment, attendance, PTO, holidays, code of conduct, technology use, and social media.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Document Package
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this employment document package for missing placeholders, inconsistent terms, unclear obligations, jurisdiction issues, and clauses that need licensed counsel review: [paste text].

output_examples.input: Draft an offer letter for a remote full-time software engineer with salary, benefits, background check, and acceptance deadline.
output_examples.output: A complete offer letter with position details, compensation terms, benefits summary, contingencies, at-will notice, acceptance instructions, and signature blocks.

output_examples.input: Create an employment agreement outline for a senior sales hire with confidential information access and commission eligibility.
output_examples.output: An agreement structure covering employment duties, term, salary and commission, expenses, confidentiality, IP, non-solicitation review points, termination, and acknowledgments.

output_examples.input: Prepare employee handbook policies for PTO, sick leave, holidays, workplace conduct, and technology use.
output_examples.output: A policy section with plain-language rules, employee obligations, manager approval points, security expectations, and an acknowledgment block.

best_practices: Confirm jurisdiction, employment type, exempt status, and required clauses before drafting.
Replace every placeholder with reviewed company facts before sharing a document.
Have qualified counsel review final documents before signature or publication.
anti_patterns: Using the templates as final legal advice without local review.
Leaving placeholders, inconsistent dates, or conflicting compensation terms in the document.
Adding non-compete or IP terms without checking enforceability.

faq.question: What documents can this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps draft offer letters, employment agreements, employee handbook sections, and related HR policy language.

faq.question: Does this skill provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It provides drafting templates and checklists that should be reviewed by qualified legal counsel.

faq.question: Can it handle jurisdiction-specific requirements?
faq.answer: It can prompt for jurisdiction and flag review needs, but it does not replace local legal analysis.

faq.question: Can it revise an existing document?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the document text and request checks for placeholders, inconsistent terms, missing clauses, and unclear obligations.

faq.question: Which tools support this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What information should I provide before drafting?
faq.answer: Provide the jurisdiction, role, employment type, compensation, benefits, start date, company policies, and required clauses.
